model_name: Search Intent Nearest-Centroid Classifier (Qwen reviewed, 82 topics)
training_source: （清洗）0922-0928关键词搜索结果资讯和视频曝光点击.xlsx
training_sheet: 相关资讯 / 第一个工作表
training_text: 搜索词 + 最多5条按点击UV排序的关联资讯标题；推理时可提供一条上下文标题
algorithm: L2-normalized mean embedding prototype per Qwen-reviewed final topic; assign by highest cosine similarity
score_interpretation: Cosine similarity is a ranking/confidence signal, not a probability.
manual_review_rule: Recommend review when top cosine similarity is below the training 5th percentile, the top-two margin is below 0.02, or the predicted topic has fewer than 3 training terms.

source_clustering.algorithm: MiniBatchKMeans; L2-normalized semantic vectors; 70 initial topics; seed 42

training_label_similarity.note: In-sample fit to the supplied unsupervised/Qwen-reviewed labels; not an independent accuracy estimate.
